items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I played drums with Chauncey's band

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. She played for a theatre there, and she also played for another theatre in Kansas City, Kansas. So I went to school in Kansas City, Kansas, and I was looking through a book the other day and I saw a name, Chauncey Downs. And I remember that my mother played with him at Excelsor Springs, Missouri, and they didn't have a drummer and I played drums and I had never played drums before in my life. But I played drums with Chauncey's band, and I had the opportunity to see him -- I only lived there for a…
